utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Wednesday the sixteenth. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the silent-film thing again?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: You're on. I was just saying, weekend plans are looking a bit soggy. Supposed to be walking, but have you seen the weather?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: It's Wednesday. Plenty of time for the forecast to be wrong in three different ways.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: While we're on important matters, whose new car is that in the car park? Very brave, parking something that shiny here.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one with the protective coating of factory dust.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Anyone see the football last night? Honestly, ninety minutes I'm never getting back.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we lose another ninety. Where are we with yesterday's bits?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, tested the BFP yesterday and it's all fine now. That testing's done.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That's yesterday's test you're closing out, yeah? Not another test on today's list?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. Completed work, not a fresh job.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the PRV on the boiler yesterday. That's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, so that filter change isn't still hanging over us?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, all done. Just making sure it doesn't get counted twice.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: One observation from nights: noticed the Water Booster Pump was running a bit warm, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, the settled-down bit's worth saying. Otherwise that sounds rather more exciting than it was.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Exactly. Just an observation, not raising another job off it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Pricey, can you check the guarding on the stacker by 11am? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll check the guarding on the stacker. I've got that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And that's the production hold we're talking about, rather than a routine look round?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. It's holding production up, so that check is right at the front.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Understood. By 11am, not sometime before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, can you also investigate the pressure drop on the boiler feed pump, today at 2pm? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Right, um, both production blockers with me, then? Just making sure I haven't heard two different versions of first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Both are ahead of routine work. The guarding has the earlier deadline, by 11am; the pressure-drop investigation is today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the boiler feed pump, today at 2pm. Those two take priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Just to separate that from what I said earlier—yesterday's BFP test was fine. I'm not saying that explains away this pressure drop.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, understood. The investigation's still needed; I'm not assuming a cause from yesterday's result.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Haley, can you send the shift handover report round today at 2pm? Normal priority on that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round today at 2pm. Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped a bit there. Two, was it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Two, yes, today at 2pm. Normal priority, not an emergency shout.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Got it. Teams picked a good moment to eat half a sentence.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: On the blocked stuff, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the spinner. Nothing's changed there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, still blocked. We're not adding a new chasing job in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the newer turbine, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: So definitely not part of today's work, that belt?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Definitely not. Off today's list, not something we're trying to squeeze in.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: The live one for me—I'll take vibration readings on the turbine one compressor by Thursday. Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, Reidy. The turbine one compressor readings are your drop-everything job.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep. By Thursday, and ahead of my less urgent stuff.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right. Different from the belt that's been pushed out. Easy to mash those together when everyone's talking.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. And I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team for Monday. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Reidy. Toolbox talk for Monday agreed, without bumping the vibration readings.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's it. Important, but not a drop-everything one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, can you recalibrate the sensors on the relief valve tomorrow morning? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that as well. With the guarding and pressure-drop investigation already with me, I haven't got room for it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Reidy, can you take that instead—recalibrate the sensors on the relief valve tomorrow morning? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that instead. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the relief valve tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And just so nobody hears 'valve' and crosses off the wrong thing, my completed bit was the filter on the PRV on the boiler.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, separate things. That filter swap is finished; this sensor recalibration has just gone to Reidy.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Got it. Tomorrow morning for the relief valve sensors. Matters, but it's not urgent; the vibration readings keep the drop-everything priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And the toolbox talk is Monday, not something you're trying to fit in this morning?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Monday, yes. I'll organise it for then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Mine's straightforward: handover report round today at 2pm, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I've got the guarding on the stacker by 11am, then the pressure drop on the boiler feed pump, today at 2pm. Not the relief valve calibration.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Both your production-blocking jobs stay ahead of routine work.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Lovely. That's clearer than my weekend forecast, anyway.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Your weekend forecast is waterproof trousers and disappointment.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, any confusion left before we finish?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: None here. Mine were completed updates only, nothing new for today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: All clear. The spinner delivery's still blocked, and the newer turbine belt isn't back on today's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. That's us, then. Thanks, everyone.
